meta.title: Class-less version
meta.lead: Embrace minimalism with Pico’s `.classless` version, a semantic option for wild HTML purists who prefer a stripped-down approach.

blocks.md: In this version, `<header>`, `<main>`, and `<footer>` inside `<body>` act as [containers](https://picocss.com/docs/container) to define a centered or a fluid viewport.
